visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A female character with short brown hair and round glasses wearing a light grey sleeveless top sits in an office setting. Behind her is a monitor and a certificate on the wall. She gestures with her hands as she speaks directly to the camera. (2) A close-up graphic of a human face's skin lines and an eye area with diamond-patterned wrinkles overlays the screen. The woman continues to speak, gesturing towards her own eyes. (3) A diagram illustrating 'Blaschko's lines' on three human head profiles (front, side, and back) appears on the screen. The woman uses both hands to trace lines from her eyes towards her ears to demonstrate the concept. (4) The woman puts on her glasses and holds a smartphone, continuing her explanation. The lighting remains bright and steady throughout. (5) The screen transitions to a white background with the clinic's logo, social media handles, and contact information for two different locations.
